about: Native Stop hook input recorded from a real Claude Code run, sanitized.

provenance.artifact_redaction: The committed artifact is the raw capture with the container home directory written as {container_home}; sha256 covers the raw bytes, artifact_sha256 the committed ones.
provenance.normalization: Session id, prompt id, transcript path and cwd replaced with fixed synthetic values; free-text strings replaced with a placeholder; keys, booleans, enum values and structure kept as recorded.
